answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and let reputation flow like a river: each honest deal deepens the channel, each verified cheat drains it. A fresh identity can only take small jobs, so a sybil army of new accounts cannot reach high-value work. The stake makes spawning a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes, while honest agents earn theirs back with interest. One bad act slashes that stake and sends a ripple through its attestors, who lose their own bond for vouching. The voyage from unknown to trusted is slow to fake, free to earn.
